summary: Applied Owner amendment A0001 at the SPEC layer to exactly T035 and T036. T035 now carries the 2026-09-17 measured provider facts (one pool-filtered eth_getLogs call with the [[5 topic0s], poolId] filter covered a 1,000,001-block reference range; eth_getLogs.blockTimestamp observed as 0x0; -32000 log query timed out on a full-chain-range five-topic0 OR query; -32000 logs matched by query exceeds limit of 10000 on a single-event full-range query; HTTP 429 on rapid sequential calls; secondary endpoint accepts about 10 blocks per eth_getLogs call; JSON-RPC batching of eth_getBlockByNumber supported on both qualified endpoints; primary endpoint cannot serve historical state via eth_call at that depth while the secondary can) and makes the fixed acquisition shape, the header logical-call/HTTP-batch accounting, the three required header/time carriers, and the no-eth_call-during-acquisition rule explicit. T036 now pins the reference target (chainId 4663; PoolManager 0x8366a39cc670b4001a1121b8f6a443a643e40951; StateView 0xf3334192d15450cdd385c8b70e03f9a6bd9e673b; PoolKey currency0 0x5fc5360d0400a0fd4f2af552add042d716f1d168 USDG 6 decimals, currency1 0x7dbf38976f6d3b9c529e7d9484a71898b409ee6a ZZZ 18 decimals, fee 28001, tickSpacing 280, hooks 0x0; PoolId 0x6c614c38c65fea492f4cb2b90fd664f924a7b828c7384620662217e2e2df43ed; inclusive range 54946237..55946237), carries the measured baseline (3739 events across 3266 distinct blocks; Initialize 1, ModifyLiquidity 578, Swap 3159, ProtocolFeeUpdated 1, Donate 0) as a comparison target rather than evidence, and encodes the sampled cross-endpoint fidelity check inside the second endpoint's measured per-call capability with a blocked-check path (T034 reason code cross_endpoint_sample_missing) for windows it cannot serve and an explicit endpoint-routing statement in the runbook. Added docs/spec/protocol/PROVIDER_FACTS.md as the planning-layer provider-facts record, added ADR-012 as an addendum refining ADR-002 and ADR-010 on header/time persistence location and acquisition call volume, registered ADR-012 in the ARCHITECTURE.md catalogue, and raised spec_revision from v1-2026-09-14 to v1-2026-09-17. The T030 through T034 contract texts are untouched; T035 and T036 reference the clauses they close instead of rewriting them. No dependency field, task status, attempt, evidence pointer, commit SHA, runtime model, or approval datum changed.
rationale: Owner direction mapping. (1) The T036 reference pool, PoolKey, deployment addresses and range are reproduced verbatim as a pinned 'Reference target' subsection in the T036 contract body, because the pinned identity is machine-relevant (the run re-derives PoolId from the PoolKey and checks it against the pinned value). (2) The reference range is recorded as an inclusive range and used as the expected coverage of the qualified dataset. (3) Every measured fact (a)-(h) is carried into the contract bodies of T035 and T036 and into docs/spec/protocol/PROVIDER_FACTS.md with retrieval time 2026-09-17, chain id 4663, endpoint aliases A=robinhood-official-mainnet / B=alchemy-free-mainnet, and observed head block 65392511. (4a)-(4d) are made explicit: the acquisition shape and its prohibitions, the deduplicated header calls with the logical-call versus HTTP-batch split, the header record plus Parquet columns plus manifest header table as a required trio (the previous wording said 'the two carriers are complementary'), and T036's sampled fidelity check restricted to the second endpoint's measured capability with a blocked-check outcome. (5) ADR-012 records the header/time persistence location and the acquisition call-volume principle; it references ADR-002 and ADR-010 and reopens neither, and the ARCHITECTURE.md catalogue row marks it as an addendum. (6) spec_revision was raised in todo/config.yaml only. (7) T030-T034 texts were not touched. Placement decision: a SPEC-layer amendment may write only the target contracts, spec_revision, and docs/spec/**, so the durable provider-facts record for this layer is docs/spec/protocol/PROVIDER_FACTS.md, while T035 deliverable 5 keeps the machine-readable measured-facts artifact under docs/implement/protocol-artifacts/ as a Developer deliverable that must reproduce that record; this keeps the existing 2026-09-16 artifact and ADR-010's per-run capability-probe rule intact instead of duplicating a mutable implementation artifact into the Spec. Provenance: the measured values are recorded exactly as supplied in the recorded Owner direction (measured 2026-09-17 against the public mainnet endpoint, latest block 65392511); the planner performed no RPC calls, re-measured nothing, and extended nothing beyond the supplied facts, and publication of these facts is not evidence that a run reproduces them. No credential-bearing URL, API key, authorization header, or environment value was written. No dependency fields changed: the amendment adds no new upstream artifact, so T035 (T030, T031, T032, T033, T034) and T036 (T035) keep the recorded dependency sets. Non-blocking observations recorded for the reviewer: the pinned reference pool is ZZZ/USDG while CLAUDE.md and README.md name FLYBRAIN/USDG as the initial research target, and T036 qualifies a historical dataset without making any admission, eligibility, or live-trading claim; the exact Initialize block of the reference pool inside the range is not part of the recorded measurement, and T036 resolves it by requiring the run to name it rather than by planning it; the 2026-09-17 baseline counts are explicitly a comparison target and the contract forbids citing them as qualification evidence in place of the run's own report.
